name: print-social-dark-toggle-bubble-highlight-tutorial-post
title: Dark Toggle Bubble Highlight Tutorial
whatItIs: A charcoal tutorial post, step 02 of a UI recipe: a glowing number bubble, italic headline, instruction text and a dark pill toggle with a large white oval highlight, and a link bar at the foot.
whatItMeans: A tactile dark UI with one white shape shows the exact technique being taught. Muted greys make the white highlight the star.
techniques: Numbered glowing bubble as step marker
Italic sans headline for a dynamic feel
Oversized enlarged component as the demonstration
Soft inner shadows for a tactile surface
Rounded link bar with contact and offer text

vocabulary.definition: A rounded shape marking the selected item in a switch.
A numbered circle indicating a step.
Interface with subtle raised and inset shadows.
